## [1.0.0-dev.64](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.0-dev.63...v1.0.0-dev.64) (2026-11-06)

### ✨ New Features

* Rework the status editor layout with hunger state buttons and the hunger summary ([bc0f8fd](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/bc0f8fd72a438552bbea5cc6f72acd3f41b4cfc4))

patches.name: Character editor
patches.description: Edit your hero's stats, talents, subclass, armor ability, modifiers and status effects.

patches.name: Enemy editor
patches.description: Edit any creature's health, side, behavior and status effects.

patches.name: Floor editor
patches.description: Edit the tiles, traps, plants, area effects, items and creatures on the current floor, and draw the floor by dragging.

patches.name: Hunger editor
patches.description: Change how long each hunger stage lasts and how starving hurts, or switch hunger off.

patches.name: Inventory editor
patches.description: Edit gold, energy and every item, add any item, and identify or uncurse everything. Adds unlimited inventory space and Weapons, Armor and Rings backpack tabs.

patches.name: QoL enhancements
patches.description: Confirm risky taps, a calmer shopkeeper, a Quantum Chest on boss floors, bigger bags and extra toolbar item slots.

patches.name: Save management
patches.description: Export and import all saves as a zip, and keep up to 10 saves of each game. Optional public, uncompressed save files.

options.description: Stores save files in a public folder on the device so they can be opened with any file manager. Asks for storage access on first launch and copies existing saves over.
Folder for the public save folder, relative to the root of the device storage.
Writes save files as plain JSON instead of GZIP so they can be edited in any text editor. Existing compressed saves still load and are converted the next time the game saves.
Shows the game's private save folder in the system file picker and Files app.

patches.name: Supporter options
patches.description:
NOTICE: This patch is not intended to gain these bonus extras for free. It is meant to ensure supporters are able to keep the benefits they paid for. Don't be a scumbag. Please support the developer!

Keep your supporter rewards and hide the Support button. Google Play version only.

patches.name: Teleport
patches.description: Teleport to any floor, and teleport your hero or other creatures to any tile.

patches.name: Unlock all
patches.description: Show all heroes, guides, lore, catalog items and bestiary entries as unlocked without changing your save.
